ficha.tema: Conjunto de ícones 3D para um documentário de geopolítica do petróleo (Estreito de Ormuz)
ficha.contexto: Ícones que entram sobre mapas de satélite e painéis escuros: precisam ser legíveis pequenos e ter o mesmo acabamento entre si.
ficha.estilo: consistent glossy 3D emoji icon set, same render style, same lighting and same level of detail for every icon
ficha.iluminacao: soft studio key light from the top left, gentle rim light
evitar: any green color on the object

imagens.descricao: A classic 55-gallon steel oil drum standing upright, glossy dark navy blue body with two raised rings, a small orange cap on the top lid, slight three-quarter view from above.

A large crude oil tanker ship in three-quarter side view, dark red hull below the waterline, black upper hull, white bridge superstructure at the stern, pipes on the deck, sitting on a tiny stylized blue water splash.
An LNG carrier ship in three-quarter side view with four large white spherical tanks on deck, dark blue hull, white bridge at the stern, on a tiny stylized blue water splash.
An oil pumpjack (nodding donkey) in orange and dark grey steel, three-quarter view, on a small sand-colored base.
A short section of a large steel oil pipeline on two supports, with a red valve wheel on top, three-quarter view, the pipe in light steel grey.
A cylindrical oil storage tank, white with a dark grey roof and a spiral staircase around it, three-quarter view, on a small concrete base.
A generic modern grey naval frigate in three-quarter side view, smooth stealthy shapes, a single gun at the bow, plain grey with no numbers, flags or insignia, on a tiny stylized blue water splash.
A classic spherical naval sea mine with protruding contact horns, dark gunmetal with a subtle red band, slight three-quarter view.
A small 16th-century stone sea fortress with low thick walls and round corner bastions on a rocky islet, warm sandstone color, three-quarter view, no flags.
A 16th-century carrack sailing ship (nau) with three masts and plain cream-colored sails without any symbols, wooden brown hull, three-quarter view, on a tiny stylized blue water splash.
A closed padlock with a thick shackle, glossy red body and steel shackle, slight three-quarter view.
A wide-body passenger airliner seen from below at three-quarter angle, white fuselage, plain with no logos, no text and no livery.
A hand giving a thumbs up (like gesture), warm yellow skin tone like an emoji hand, glossy, three-quarter view.
A golden notification bell with a small clapper and two short motion lines, glossy gold, slight tilt.
A rounded speech bubble (chat balloon) in glossy white with three small dark dots inside, slight three-quarter view.
A thick curved arrow pointing to the right and up (share symbol), glossy bright blue, slight three-quarter view.
